cases.title: Startup refuses a bad flag, a missing root and a missing exe; a good start prints the ready line
cases.evidence:
> (CP-3) Copy-Item ..\cli\testdata\*.TPS work\ -Force
> node dist\server.js --bogus
  stderr: tpscli-mcp: unknown option --bogus
  exit 2
> node dist\server.js --root C:\no\such\folder
  stderr: tpscli-mcp: --root C:\no\such\folder is not a folder
  exit 2
> node dist\server.js --exe C:\no\tpscli.exe
  stderr: tpscli-mcp: tpscli.exe not found; tried C:\no\tpscli.exe. Pass --exe <path> or set TPSCLI_EXE.
  exit 2
> node dist\server.js --timeout 0
  stderr: tpscli-mcp: --timeout needs a positive whole number of seconds, not 0
  exit 2
> node dist\server.js --root work
  stderr: tpscli-mcp 0.2.0 ready: exe C:\Projects\GitHub\tpscli\cli\tpscli.exe; roots C:\Projects\GitHub\tpscli\mcp\work; writes disabled; owner none; timeout 60s
  exit 0

cases.title: tps_version pairs the server and exe versions
tps_list_files lists the roots or a directory and filters by pattern; tps_set_roots changes the roots at runtime
tps_describe shows the layout of a file by bare name or absolute path
tps_select builds where, order_by and limit, and reports truncation
format table returns the exe's text grid, and its one-line failure
